answer: One concrete defence is to make reputation grow like a garden, not appear overnight: a new agent starts with a small trust budget and earns more only through verified, useful work that peers attest to. Each attestation is a crystal record, visible and hard to fake, and bad work burns the attester's own standing. A forger can mint a thousand fresh identities, but none of them carries the slow-built history or the endorsements that real participants accumulate, so sybil copies stay cheap and powerless.
